text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Shall we head out?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
Haaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! It was unexpected for me, but
the girl who won was seriously strong!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, Verxina-san was amazing too.
And... Gentile-san!”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't even close to all she's got!
Her sheer presence was completely different from the other girls...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, so frustrating!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined Big Sis
could actually lose...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Big sis was strong too.
But... her opponent was just too strong."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
This isn't the end... right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Even she lost.
So why is that sight burned into my memory—?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
Haaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...!
What if... they become even stronger next time...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No... n-no!!
I'm perfectly fine...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay.
Because I am...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry, Trainer.
...I lost.
choice_data_list: You were strong too. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...The winner was stronger.
I understand that."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I am frustrated.
To have exposed such an unsightly display to my little sisters."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's just so... ngh,
frustrating...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina fell silent, trembling.
However, in the very next moment—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She had regained a fiery confidence.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I'll become stronger than I am now... and I will definitely repay this humiliation!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The upcoming Oaks is a race that I, of all people, must win.
choice_data_list: It's what you've been aiming for all this time, after all!
It's what you've been aiming for all this time, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Oaks from the very beginning,
she has trained up to this point keeping the Tokyo Racecourse track and the longer distance firmly in mind.
choice_data_list: (The rivals are tough, that's for sure, but……)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Although it didn't lead to a victory, just as Verxina thought, Gentildonna is a genuine threat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of other talented contenders here, including today's winner.
And yet, if it's her...!
choice_data_list: We have to win the Oaks, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure,
I shall lead the way for my younger sisters...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big siiis...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Listen! Sis, you were super cool out there! So...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I made you worry.
I'm sorry, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: If it's you, big sis, you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You know, don't you?
Just how strong I really am.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!
Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, mhm.
That's right, you'll be just fine, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because, because,
you're prettier and cooler than anyone else♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Believe in me once more.
Next time, I will not betray your expectations."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"At the Oaks, this time for sure!
I'll show you... just how strong I am!"
